meta.name: Label and triage support emails in Gmail with DeepSeek or OpenAI

name: AI Email Triage FREE (Classify + Label, no auto-reply)

parameters.content:
## AI Email Triage FREE (Classify + Label, no auto-reply)

### How it works

This workflow monitors Gmail for incoming messages and filters out noise before processing. Emails that pass the conditional check are sent to an AI classification endpoint, then the returned category is parsed and mapped to a Gmail label. The workflow finishes by applying the chosen label to the email, with no automatic reply sent.

### Setup steps

- Connect Gmail credentials for both the Gmail Trigger and Gmail label application node.
- Configure the Gmail Trigger mailbox, polling behavior, and any search criteria needed for incoming messages.
- Add the DeepSeek API key or authorization header to the AI HTTP Request node and confirm the model, endpoint, and request body match your account.
- Create or verify the Gmail labels referenced by the mapping code, and update label IDs/names in the Parse & Map Label node if needed.

### Customization

Adjust the Skip Noise code and IF condition to change which emails are ignored. Update the AI prompt, classification categories, and label mapping logic to match your triage system.

## Receive and filter email

Starts when a new Gmail message arrives, runs custom noise-filtering logic, and uses a conditional check to decide whether the email should continue to AI processing.

## Classify with AI

Sends the selected email content to the DeepSeek chat completions API to classify the message for triage.

## Map and apply label

Parses the AI classification, maps it to a Gmail label, and applies that label to the original message without sending any auto-reply.
